propositions: Reconciler jql_active query hardcodes status != 'Done' literal, which fails to exclude custom Done-equivalent statuses like Closed/Resolved/Cancelled used in client workflows, causing those issues to be incorrectly pulled into the active working set.
Reconciler jql_done_recent query hardcodes status = 'Done' literal, which fails to capture custom Done-equivalent statuses, causing those issues to be missed from the recent-Done snapshot.

The solution migrates both jql_active and jql_done_recent from literal status predicates to Jira statusCategory predicates (statusCategory != Done / statusCategory = Done), which are workflow-agnostic and capture all Done-equivalent statuses.
All existing tests for single-project and multi-project fan-out behavior pass with statusCategory logic, and DIG/REB workflow behavior (using only To Do/In Progress/Done) remains identical.
